title: 第23章 百兽门的腹泻危机第24章 呼噜灵域诞生
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
御兽宗戒律堂的冰冷石阶上，赵管事被两个执法弟子粗暴地拖行。
他肥硕的身躯在粗粝的地面摩擦，昂贵的绸缎外袍被刮得褴褛不堪，沾满泥污和血痕。
三年俸禄、所有资源供给、寒冰洞面壁一年！
这判决如同三把淬毒的冰锥，狠狠扎进他心窝。
寒冰洞那种鬼地方，灵气稀薄，寒气蚀骨，待上一年，他这把老骨头就算不死，修为也必定大跌！
绝望和怨毒在他浑浊的老眼里疯狂交织。
“林墨…小畜生！
都是你！
都是你害的！”
赵坤喉咙里发出受伤野兽般的嗬嗬低吼，指甲深深抠进地面，留下几道带血的划痕。
王莽那几个废物失手被猫发现，毒泥反噬药田，证据确凿！
这哑巴亏他吃得五脏六腑都在燃烧！
他不敢想象在寒冰洞暗无天日的日子，更不敢想象失去一切后，那些平日对他点头哈腰的杂役、管事会如何落井下石。
一股冰冷的恨意，如同附骨之蛆，彻底吞噬了他仅存的理智。
---
就在赵坤被拖入后山禁地深处的同时，百兽门门主熊天罡正处在狂暴的边缘。
灵兽谷的恶臭弥漫不散，数百头精心培育的灵兽瘫软在地，痛苦呻吟，排泄物污染了大片珍贵的灵土。
门中丹师和药师忙得焦头烂额，各种解毒、固本的丹药像不要钱似的灌下去，却收效甚微。
疾风狼群的哀鸣如同钝刀，一下下割在熊天罡的心上。
“门主！”

一个管事连滚爬爬地冲进临时搭建的救治棚，手里捧着几株枯黄萎蔫、根部沾着诡异黑泥的“提神草”
，正是昨日从赵坤那里采购的“灵草”
“丹房…丹房分析出来了！
草里混了‘枯肠散’！
还有…还有一丝枯脉散的变异死气！
双重毒性，专门破坏灵兽肠胃经络，腐蚀灵力根基啊！”
“枯脉散？！”
熊天罡铜铃般的眼睛瞬间充血，联想到昨日隐约听到的关于废丹峰水源投毒的传言，一切豁然贯通！
赵坤！
御兽宗！
他们竟敢把沾染了投毒失败残留物的毒草，伪装成“提神草”
卖给他百兽门！
这已不是简单的商业欺诈，这是蓄谋的谋杀！
谋杀他百兽门未来的根基！
“啊——！
！”
熊天罡的怒吼声震得整个救治棚簌簌发抖，狂暴的金丹威压不受控制地爆发，将旁边的药架掀翻，瓶瓶罐罐碎了一地。
content_en:
On the cold stone steps of the Beast Control Sect's Discipline Hall, Manager Zhao was roughly dragged along by two law enforcement disciples.
His fat body rubbed against the rough ground, and his expensive satin robe was scratched to pieces and stained with mud and blood.
Three years of salary, all resources provided, and one year facing the ice cave wall!
This sentence was like three poisoned ice picks, piercing into his heart.
In a ghost place like the Ice Cave, the spiritual energy is thin and the cold air corrodes the bones. If he stays there for a year, even if his old bones are not dead, his cultivation level will definitely plummet!
Despair and resentment intertwined crazily in his cloudy old eyes.
"Lin Mo... little beast!
It's all you!
It's all your fault! "
Zhao Kun roared like a wounded beast from his throat, and dug his nails deeply into the ground, leaving several bloody scratches.
Wang Mang's losers were accidentally discovered by a cat, and the poisonous mud backfired in the medicine field. The evidence is conclusive!
This mute's internal organs were burning thanks to his food!
He couldn't imagine the dark days in the Ice Cave, let alone how those handymen and stewards who usually nodded and bowed to him would make trouble after losing everything.
A cold hatred, like maggots attached to his bones, completely swallowed up his remaining sanity.
---
At the same time that Zhao Kun was dragged into the depths of the forbidden area in the back mountain, Xiong Tiangang, the leader of the Hundred Beast Sect, was on the verge of going berserk.
The stench of the Spirit Beast Valley lingered. Hundreds of carefully cultivated spirit beasts lay limp on the ground, moaning in pain, and their excrement contaminated a large area of ​​precious spiritual soil.
The alchemists and pharmacists in the sect were extremely busy, pouring down all kinds of detoxifying and strengthening elixirs as if they were free, but with little effect.
The whines of the gale-wind wolves were like blunt knives, cutting into Xiong Tiangang's heart.
"Master!"
A steward rushed into the temporary treatment shed, holding in his hand a few withered "refreshing grass" plants with strange black mud on their roots.
, it is the "spiritual grass" purchased from Zhao Kun yesterday
“The alchemy room…the alchemy room has been analyzed!
There’s ‘Kuchang Powder’ mixed in the grass!
And...there is also a trace of the mutated death energy of Kumai San!
Double toxicity, specially designed to destroy the gastrointestinal meridians of spiritual beasts and corrode the foundation of spiritual power! "
"Kumei Powder?!"
Xiong Tiangang's copper bell-like eyes were instantly bloodshot. Thinking of the rumors he vaguely heard yesterday about the poisoning of the water source of the Waste Dan Peak, everything suddenly became clear!
Zhao Kun!
Beast Control Sect!
How dare they disguise poisonous weeds contaminated with the residue of failed poisonings as "energizing herbs"
Sell him the Beast Gate!
This is no longer a simple commercial fraud, this is a premeditated murder!
Murder the future foundation of his Hundred Beast Sect!
"Ah——!
! "
Xiong Tiangang's roar made the entire treatment shed tremble, and the violent golden elixir burst out uncontrollably, overturning the medicine shelf next to it, and shattering bottles and cans on the floor.
